title: Marmots (medium)
statementMd:
Good job! Now that Heidi is able to distinguish between Poisson and uniform distributions, she is in a good position to actually estimate the populations.

Can you help Heidi estimate each village's population?

## Input

Same as the easy version.

## Output

Output one line per village, in the same order as provided in the input, containing your (integer) population estimate.

Your answer is considered correct if it is an integer that falls into the interval ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9b72673bc9d128acd2b73380ee4665d926ccfce8.png), where $*P*$ is the real population of the village, used to create the distribution (either Poisson or uniform) from which the marmots drew their answers.
statementZhMd:
干得不错！现在 Heidi 已经能够区分泊松分布和均匀分布，她已经具备了实际估计各村庄人口的条件。

你能帮助 Heidi 估计每个村庄的人口吗？

## 输入格式

与简单版本相同。

## 输出格式

按照输入中给出的顺序，对于每个村庄输出一行，其中包含你估计的（整数）人口。

如果你的答案是一个落在区间 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9b72673bc9d128acd2b73380ee4665d926ccfce8.png) 内的整数，则认为答案正确，其中 $*P*$ 是村庄的真实人口，用于生成土拨鼠给出答案所依据的分布（泊松分布或均匀分布）。
